title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A Japanese office worker is killed and reborn in a fantasy world as a slime with power to absorb skills. Named Rimuru, he befriends monsters and builds the nation of Tempest, navigating diplomacy and war with human and demon powers (to verify).
life_message: A life of building a peaceful, cooperative community and protecting it.

content.note: War arcs and massacre retaliation (AniList War 75%) (to verify).
